categories.main_business_segments: The company is a professional provider of industrial non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment and solutions. Its main business segments include: (1) Industrial non-destructive testing equipment, including portable ultrasonic phased array flaw detectors, ultrasonic board card detection equipment, and automated detection systems; (2) Ultrasonic transducers, including phased array ultrasonic transducers, industrial ultrasonic transducers, and medical ultrasonic transducers; (3) Supporting components including scanning devices, wedges, and coupling agents. The company serves industries such as special equipment, rail transit, aerospace, energy and power, steel metallurgy, new energy vehicles, and third-party testing institutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies center on ultrasonic phased array (PAUT) detection and full-focus (TFM) imaging technology. Key technical capabilities include: (1) High-channel parallel transmission/reception and acquisition processing; (2) 2.5ns high-precision acoustic beam delay control; (3) Low-power ultrasonic phased array transceiver technology; (4) Real-time 3D imaging technology; (5) Design and manufacturing of composite material transducers with frequencies ranging from 0.5MHz to 20MHz; (6) Customized detection software and analysis algorithms. The company manufactures products using precision electronic assembly, mechanical processing, and software development methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves multiple key industries: special equipment inspection, rail transit (high-speed rail wheels and axles), aerospace and aviation, energy and power (thermal, nuclear, wind, and hydroelectric), steel and metallurgy, new energy vehicles (power battery testing), and third-party testing institutions. Major customers include China State Railway Group, China Southern Power Grid, China National Nuclear Corporation, China Aerospace Science and Technology Group, China Aviation Industry Corporation, BYD, and international testing service providers like SGS.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with headquarters in Guangzhou, Guangdong Province. It has established regional sales and service centers across major Chinese cities. International operations include direct sales to customers in the United States, United Arab Emirates, South Korea, and other countries. The company also has a subsidiary, Dalian Ruidi Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd., based in Dalian, Liaoning Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures and sells finished non-destructive testing equipment and components directly to end-users in various industries. The company also provides integrated detection solutions and technical services, positioning itself as both a product manufacturer and solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or pure service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic R&D focus includes: (1) Development of higher-performance detection equipment with improved resolution and speed; (2) Specialized and customized detection methods for specific applications; (3) Automation and intelligence of detection systems; (4) Localization of core components and algorithms to reduce import dependence; (5) Integration of multiple NDT technologies for comprehensive detection; (6) In-service monitoring and big data analysis capabilities; (7) Expansion into medical device applications through its newly established medical subsidiary. The company maintains high R&D investment at 23.70% of revenue.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of non-destructive testing equipment and components. Revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company operates on a direct sales model domestically and a combination of direct sales and distribution internationally. Revenue streams include: (1) Industrial detection equipment sales (43.49% of revenue); (2) Ultrasonic transducer sales (35.02% of revenue); (3) Supporting component sales (19.85% of revenue). The company also provides technical support, training, and customized solution services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider of ultrasonic phased array detection equipment in China. It competes with both international equipment manufacturers and emerging domestic competitors. The company's competitive advantages include: advanced phased array and full-focus imaging technology, comprehensive product lines from components to complete systems, strong customer relationships with major state-owned enterprises and aerospace companies, and proven technical expertise recognized through national awards and certifications. The company is among the few domestic manufacturers capable of independently developing and producing ultrasonic transducers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized technology enterprise with 2024 revenue of 162.00 million yuan, down 18.70% from 199.26 million yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 51.60 million yuan in 2024, down 33.68% from 77.81 million yuan in 2023. Total assets reached 1.544 billion yuan at year-end 2024, with shareholders' equity of 1.502 billion yuan. The company went public on the ChiNext board in August 2023. The revenue decline in 2024 was primarily due to delayed customer equipment purchases and extended delivery timelines for large automated detection system orders.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key value propositions include: (1) Advanced phased array and full-focus imaging technology providing superior detection accuracy and speed compared to conventional methods; (2) Comprehensive integrated solutions from components to complete automated systems tailored to specific industry needs; (3) Domestic technological independence reducing reliance on foreign equipment and avoiding supply chain disruptions; (4) Proven reliability and quality recognized through national awards, certifications, and adoption by major state-owned enterprises and aerospace companies; (5) Strong technical support and customization capabilities for complex detection scenarios; (6) Cost-effective alternatives to imported equipment while maintaining international-level performance standards.
